dialogue.content: こんにちは。本日はどうぞよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Hello. Thank you for coming today. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんにちは！お願い致します
dialogue.English: Hello! Thank you for having me.

dialogue.content: 5分前なのですがよろしければ始めさせてもらってもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: We're five minutes early, but if it's all right with you, may we begin?

dialogue.content: はい、お願いします
dialogue.English: Yes, please.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。では、スタートさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. Then, let's begin. I look forward to our session.

dialogue.content: こんにちは。相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Hello. I'm your counselor. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: はい、コロナ関係のことで気持ちが滅入っています。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm feeling down about things related to COVID.

dialogue.content: コロナ、、でそれはしんどいですよね
dialogue.English: Ah, the coronavirus... I can imagine that's very tough.

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 具体的にどんな事が気が滅入るような事があったんでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could you tell me more specifically what has been making you feel down?

dialogue.content: 話せることからで良いのでお話くださいね
dialogue.English: Please feel free to start with whatever you're comfortable sharing.

dialogue.content: はい、せっかく色々動きだしたかに見えたのに
dialogue.English: Yes, just when it seemed like things were finally starting to move forward...

dialogue.content: ええ
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: また、感染者が増えて憂鬱です
dialogue.English: But now the number of cases is increasing again, and it's making me feel depressed.

dialogue.content: 生活に影響することが多いですから、、憂鬱な気持ちだと気持ちが落ち込みますよね
dialogue.English: It affects so many parts of daily life... it's understandable that you'd feel low and discouraged.

dialogue.content: 仕事が元に戻り始めたのに、もうダメかなと…やる気が出ません
dialogue.English: Work was just starting to get back to normal, but now I feel like it's hopeless... I can't muster any motivation.

dialogue.content: 頑張ろうという気持ちなのに悔しいですよね。心が折れそうな気持ちですよね。動き始めたのは仕事の事が大きいのでしょうか、、？
dialogue.English: It must be so frustrating when you were trying so hard. It feels like your spirit is about to break. Was it mainly your work that was getting back into motion?

dialogue.content: そうですね
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.content: 例えば、コロナでどのような事が止まってしまったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: For example, what kind of things came to a halt because of the pandemic?

dialogue.content: 仕事は飲食業経営なんですが、ようやくキャンペーンの力もあって兆しが見えていたんです。
dialogue.English: I run a food-and-beverage business, and with the help of the campaign, signs of recovery had finally started to appear.

dialogue.content: それが…
dialogue.English: But then...

dialogue.content: もう無理な気がします
dialogue.English: I feel like it's impossible now.

dialogue.content: そんなに絶望感が強まっているほどの苦しいお気持ちなんですね、、
dialogue.English: It sounds like you're feeling such a strong sense of despair. That must be very painful.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 頑張りようがありません
dialogue.English: I don't know how to keep going.

dialogue.content: ここまで頑張ってこられているのに報われない気持ちになっていて、、どうしたら良いか、そんなお気持ちなのでしょうか、、
dialogue.English: You've come this far working so hard, yet it feels like it's not paying off, and you don't know what to do—is that how it feels?

dialogue.content: よろしければ年齢と性別を教えていただけますか
dialogue.English: If you don't mind, could you please tell me your age and gender?

dialogue.content: 56歳男性です
dialogue.English: I'm a 56-year-old man.

dialogue.content: もう少し状況をお聞きしてもよろしいでしょうか
dialogue.English: Would it be all right if I asked a little more about your situation?

dialogue.content: 年齢などお答えいただきありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing your age and other details.

dialogue.content: コロナ前よりどのくらい客数が減っている感じなのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Compared to before the pandemic, by about how much has the number of customers decreased?

dialogue.content: 5年前にお酒を出すお店を都内に出しました。暫く好評でいい感じだったのです。
dialogue.English: I opened a bar in Tokyo five years ago. For a while, it was popular and doing well.

dialogue.content: しかし、コロナの影響でいきなり経営が難しくなったんです。
dialogue.English: But because of COVID, the business suddenly became difficult to run.

dialogue.content: 春頃は閉めるつめもりでした。
dialogue.English: Around spring, I was even considering closing it down.

dialogue.content: はい。お役様にも人気のある素敵なお店だったんですね。それなのにコロナで、、閉める、と考えるほどほど苦しかったのですね
dialogue.English: I see. So it was a wonderful place, popular with customers. And yet, because of the pandemic... it must have been so difficult that you were even considering closing.

dialogue.content: ええ、家賃も払えなくなりそうでした。
dialogue.English: Yes, I was on the verge of not being able to pay rent.

dialogue.content: しかし、助成金でなんとか閉めずにもちこたえたんです。
dialogue.English: But I managed to hold on without closing, thanks to subsidies.

dialogue.content: でもその中でも、あなたの頑張りや支援でなんとか春から今まで頑張ってこられたのですね。
dialogue.English: But even with all that, through your own hard work and the support you received, you've managed to persevere since the spring.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: なのにまたコロナの影響が、、
dialogue.English: And yet COVID is affecting things again...

dialogue.content: あなたはそれで頑張ってきた気持ちが折れそうになってしまった、、
dialogue.English: ...and because of that, you feel like the spirit you had to keep trying is about to break.

dialogue.content: 先が見えなくなってきて、もう頑張りようがありません。
dialogue.English: I can't see a way forward anymore. I don't know how to keep trying.

dialogue.content: 春に爆発的にコロナの影響が出始めた時からあなたの努力でなんとか頑張ってこられているのがわかります
dialogue.English: I can see that since the surge began in the spring, you've done your utmost to hang in there.

dialogue.content: はい、あと一息と思っていたんです。
dialogue.English: Yes, I thought it was just a little more to go.

dialogue.content: そう思っていたのに裏切られた思いがして悔しさもあると思います。ちなみに、春からキャンペーン前まではどんな形の努力で持ちこたえたと思っていらっしゃいますか？
dialogue.English: Feeling that way and then having the rug pulled out from under you must be frustrating. By the way, from spring until the campaign started, what kinds of efforts helped you stay afloat?

dialogue.content: テイクアウトで新しいメニューを出したり、お酒とのセットメニューでお得感のあるように頑張りました。
dialogue.English: I introduced new takeout items and worked hard to offer value with set menus paired with drinks.

dialogue.content: なるほど、素敵なメニューですね！お得感あるのはワクワクします。
dialogue.English: I see—those sound like great offerings! Getting a good deal is exciting.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 好評でした
dialogue.English: They were well received.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。今コロナ禍のお客様のニーズに合っていると思います。
dialogue.English: I can see that. I think it meets the needs of customers during this pandemic.

dialogue.content: それらの素敵なメニューを考えだしてそれが好評でその時は手ごたえを感じていたのですね
dialogue.English: You came up with those appealing menus, they were popular, and at the time you felt you were getting some traction.

dialogue.content: でも、収入はギリギリでした。そろそろ夜の営業も起動に乗り始めていたので何とかなる予定だったのに
dialogue.English: But our income was barely enough. The nighttime business was just starting to get back on track, so I thought we would manage, but...

dialogue.content: また、営業時間の自粛要請が出ました。
dialogue.English: Then, another request to shorten business hours was issued.

dialogue.content: 営業時間を自粛してしまうと夜間営業のお店はモロに影響うけますから、その要請は本当にキツイですよね
dialogue.English: For places that operate at night, shortening hours hits directly—those requests are really tough.

dialogue.content: はい、辛いです
dialogue.English: Yes, it's painful.

dialogue.content: そんなどうなるか読めないコロナの状況や国や都からの要請もある中で、あなたは素敵なメニューを考えたりテイクアウトを行ったりしてきたんですよね。
dialogue.English: In this unpredictable COVID situation with requests from the national and metropolitan governments, you've been creating attractive menus and offering takeout.

dialogue.content: はい、しかしもう閉めなければならないかも知れません
dialogue.English: Yes, but I might have to close down now.

dialogue.content: そう思うくらい手を尽くしてきたという思いがあるのですね
dialogue.English: You feel like you've tried everything, which is why you're thinking that.

dialogue.content: ちなみに、営業時間は何時から何時ですか「？
dialogue.English: By the way, what are your current business hours?

dialogue.content: 今は11時から14時までランチタイム
dialogue.English: Right now, we have lunch from 11 a.m. to 2 p.m.

dialogue.content: それと、18時から12時のお酒を出す時間帯です。
dialogue.English: And we serve drinks from 6 p.m. to midnight.

dialogue.content: 昼と夜のどちらも営業しているのですね。それはコロナ前と同じでしょうか？
dialogue.English: So you're open for both lunch and dinner. Is that the same as before the pandemic?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: では、単純に自粛要請されると営業時間が短くなる、、だから売り上げはさがってしまう、、ということでしょうか
dialogue.English: So, simply put, the request to shorten hours means less operating time, which leads to a drop in sales, is that correct?

dialogue.content: 客足が確実に減ってきていますし、席もただでさえ減らしているので売上と仕入れのバランスが悪いのです。予測がつかなくて無駄も出てしまいます。
dialogue.English: Foot traffic is definitely decreasing, and we've already reduced seating, so the balance between sales and supplies is off. It's hard to predict, which leads to waste.

dialogue.content: そうですか、、
dialogue.English: I see...

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: コロナが始まってからこれだけ、様々な案と出してお客様を喜ばすことができるあなたは商売に向いていると思います。なんとか解決策を一緒に考えていけたらと思いますが、いかがですか？
dialogue.English: Since COVID began, you've come up with many ideas and delighted your customers; I think you have a knack for business. If you're willing, I'd like to think about possible solutions together—how does that sound?

dialogue.content: お客様に好評だったメニューもまだまだお客様にこれからも喜んでもらえると思います。
dialogue.English: I believe the menus that were popular with your customers will continue to make them happy in the future.

dialogue.content: はい、そう言っていただけると頑張る気も少し湧いてきます。ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Yes, hearing you say that gives me a little bit of motivation to try again. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 自粛要請のある間を切り抜けたらだいぶ違いますか？
dialogue.English: Would things be significantly different if you could just get through this period of restricted hours?

dialogue.content: はい、感染者拡大がいつまで続くかが勝負な感じです。
dialogue.English: Yes, it feels like the real challenge is how long this surge in cases will last.

dialogue.content: そうですね、さらに来店客数という部分が予測が付かない、だから無駄もでる、、
dialogue.English: Right, and on top of that, you can't predict the number of customers, which leads to waste...

dialogue.content: はい、これから客足が減るともたないです。
dialogue.English: Yes, if customer traffic decreases from here, we won't survive.

dialogue.content: コロナがあると外食は減ってしまっていたかもしれませんが、かたや家での食事にも疲れが出ているのもあると思います。
dialogue.English: With COVID, dining out may have decreased, but on the other hand, I think many people are getting tired of cooking at home.

dialogue.content: そうでしょうか
dialogue.English: Do you think so?

dialogue.content: はい。長く居座って飲む飲み会は後ろめたい感じがあるかもしれませんが、一日三度の食事やお惣菜などは外食やテイクアウトにしたいと思う家庭も多いと思います
dialogue.English: Yes. People might feel guilty about long drinking parties, but I think many households want to dine out or get takeout for their three daily meals or side dishes.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね？
dialogue.English: Is that so?

dialogue.content: 毎日の事ですから、主婦など料理に疲れます。実際にレトルトや簡単に調理できるキッドなどメーカーの売れ行きは良いようです
dialogue.English: It's a daily task, so homemakers and others get tired of cooking. In fact, it seems that ready-to-eat meals and easy-to-prepare meal kits are selling well.

dialogue.content: そこん狙ってみたらいいですかね？
dialogue.English: So, do you think I should aim for that market?

dialogue.content: はい、毎日食べるものですからニーズにあたるととてもヒットすると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. Since it's something people eat every day, if you meet their needs, it could be a big hit.

dialogue.content: 食べる方は美味しくてコスパ良くて、、そんなのが大好きだと思います
dialogue.English: I think people love food that's delicious and cost-effective.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。参考にします。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll keep that in mind.

dialogue.content: あなたの作るメニューはお客様にも好評のようですから少し考えたらさらに良い物ができそうだと思います。
dialogue.English: Since your menu is already popular with customers, I think you could create something even better with a little more thought.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 飲食店でのコロナ対応は、テイクアウトなどを強化している店が多いと思いますが、売れている店見ると、メニューに一工夫あると思います。
dialogue.English: In response to the pandemic, many restaurants are strengthening their takeout options, but I think the successful ones have a unique twist on their menus.

dialogue.content: あと、ＨＰなどにはテイクアウト商品など紹介していますか？
dialogue.English: Also, do you feature your takeout items on your website and the like?

dialogue.content: はい。なるほど
dialogue.English: I see. That makes sense.

dialogue.content: それはまだです。
dialogue.English: We haven't done that yet.

dialogue.content: それもやってみる価値ありだと思います。実際にＨＰやサイトから探している人もいると思います。ＳＮＳなども利用したり。
dialogue.English: I think that's also worth a try. I believe there are people who actually search on websites. You could also use social media.

dialogue.content: そういう時代ですよね？
dialogue.English: That’s the way things are these days, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい、、足を運んで買いに行ったらいまいちだったらショックなので下調べしてから行く、、それに美味しいとすぐに評判になります。
dialogue.English: Yes. People research first because it’s disappointing to go out and buy something only to find it underwhelming. And if it's tasty, word spreads quickly.

dialogue.content: はい、やってみます。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'll give it a try.

dialogue.content: まだ、自信はないですけど…
dialogue.English: I'm still not confident, though...

dialogue.content: あとは気力をつけないと
dialogue.English: And I need to build up my mental energy.

dialogue.content: はい。本当に美味しそうな料理を提供していらっしゃるあなたのお店なら、必ずお客さまに喜ばれると思います。
dialogue.English: Yes. With the delicious food your shop provides, I'm sure customers will be delighted.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。自分を信じてみたいです。
dialogue.English: Thank you. I want to try to believe in myself.

dialogue.content: このコロナの影響は人々を疲れさせて後ろ向きにさせてしまいましたが、美味しいご飯を食べれたら人は元気になれます。
dialogue.English: The impact of COVID has worn people down and made them feel negative, but a good meal can really lift people's spirits.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: そこですよね？
dialogue.English: That's the key, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 毎日何か食べます。是非、美味しい料理を作ってお客様に元気を与えてください。そしてあなたも体に気をつけてください。
dialogue.English: People eat something every day. Please, continue to make your delicious food and give your customers energy. And please take care of yourself, too.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: 料理の力って大きいと思います。これからもあなたがお元気でお仕事がうまく行くように陰で応援しています。
dialogue.English: I believe in the power of food. I'll be cheering for you from the sidelines, hoping you stay healthy and that your business goes well.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。頑張らないといけないですね？
dialogue.English: Thank you. I have to keep trying, don't I?

dialogue.content: 頑張ろうって力を入れすぎると疲弊しますから、時々は不平不満を口に出して、、いつでも話したいときにはいらしてくださいね
dialogue.English: If you push yourself too hard to do your best, you'll burn out. It's okay to voice your frustrations from time to time—please feel free to come talk whenever you’d like.

dialogue.content: はい、今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you for today.

dialogue.content: またうまく行かないと思ったら遠慮なく相談にいらしてください。こちらこそ今日はありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: If you feel things aren't going well again, please don't hesitate to come back for a consultation. Thank you for your time today as well.

dialogue.content: 時間になりましたのでロールプレイを終了してもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Our time is up, so may we end the role-play now?

dialogue.content: では終わりますね。ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: We'll wrap up now. Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、終了で大丈夫です。ありがとうございました
dialogue.English: Yes, it's fine to end now. Thank you.

dialogue.content: 勉強になりました！ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: This was a great learning experience! Thank you.
